result:
All 9 sort tests pass — 5 pre-existing and 4 new ones.

**Summary of changes:**

**`src/textual/widgets/_data_table.py` — `sort()` method (`_data_table.py:2612`)**

Added a `_default_sort_key` helper inside `sort()` that converts `Rich.Text` objects to their `.plain` string before comparison. This is applied in `key_wrapper` only when the caller has not supplied their own `key=` function. Single-column results (a scalar) and multi-column results (a tuple) are both handled.

**`tests/test_data_table.py` — 4 new regression tests:**
- `test_sort_styled_text_single_column` — single styled-text column, ascending and descending
- `test_sort_styled_text_all_columns` — no-column sort across all columns when some hold `Text`  
- `test_sort_styled_text_multiple_columns` — explicit multi-column sort with styled cells
- `test_sort_mixed_plain_and_styled` — column containing a mix of plain `str` and `Text` objects
